access.excerpt: WMT19 lines 104-105: 2019 test sets sampled online newspapers from September-November 2018. WMT20 line 82 recommends NIST or (recommended) sacreBLEU for evaluating prior test sets; line 98 says 2020 test sets sample online newspapers from September-November 2019 and source text is original online news with human-produced target translations. Line 49 says English-German test sets are produced at paragraph level.
